items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: Buddy Bolin played at Johnson Park... Buddy Bolin and Roby showed, they used to buckle against one another... I'd blow one another.

ctx.x: The train, the train used to come down on a car and go to the Union Station. It was not a car then. There was a car then. There was a car then. There was a car then. A couple of years back. Because when he entered there, and then used to come, that thing, that's fixed. It comes there, uh, you know, a tripod in there. You put different things. Bridge and trees? Tree and... A car pastes. A car pastes. A car pastes the street. You come around to that. You see. And that's what's the big house right there. It's what I…

Oh, how about a... You see, you see, Johnson Park was older than Lincoln Park. Yeah. How many years older, you see? Oh, God. It was there all the time, you know, like... Oh, yeah. I was right there. I was right there with the build. I was small. Yeah. You remember when Johnson Park was made then? Huh? Do you remember when Johnson Park was made? Oh, yeah. When they had the baseball park, right? They built it for a baseball park, and then they had... Then they turned into a little dance hall and baseball. Oh, I…
Do you remember Kallus Love? Yeah. Kallus Love. When did that come out?
